messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get

message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to the current clock, so I can’t give you the exact time right now.  
The easiest way to find the current time in New York City is to check a reliable world‑clock website or app (e.g., timeanddate.com, the built‑in clock on your phone, or a search engine query “current time New York”). That will give you the precise local time, including any daylight‑saving adjustments.
